description:
The House Papers reads the paperwork behind the most expensive things in your house.

Every week we take one system — the furnace, the AC, the panel, the roof, the water heater — and go through
the documents: who actually manufactures the brand, what the recall record says, what the warranty covers
once you read past the headline number, and what the reliability surveys show. Then we tell you which badge
is worth the check.

We don't install anything and we don't sell anything. We read filings, recall notices, warranty PDFs and
survey data, and every source is named on screen so you can check it yourself.

New video every Tuesday and Friday.
We read the paperwork, so you don't pay for it.
